build_stability_config: build an AmazonStabilityConfig instance with cfg_scale, seed, steps, width, and height parameters
create_transform_request_body: create a transformed Bedrock request body from a text prompt and optional inference parameters
transform_openai_params: transform OpenAI size parameter into width and height for Stable Diffusion models
test_transform_response: test the response transformation that converts Bedrock artifacts to OpenAI Image objects
run_cost_calculator: run the cost calculator to compute image generation cost from model, size, steps, and response data
